# Venmo payment requests task execution: find who already paid, then request for others.
from decimal import Decimal
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# login venmo
venmo_pw='gKI4^x3'
venmo_login=apis.venmo.login(username='kri-powe@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)
access_token=venmo_login['access_token']
print('venmo access_token exists', bool(access_token))

# dinner date window based on phone app 'yesterday'
phone_now=apis.phone.get_current_date_and_time()
print('phone_now', phone_now)
cur_dt=datetime.strptime(phone_now['date'], '%A, %b %d, %Y').date()
yesterday=cur_dt - timedelta(days=1)
min_date=yesterday.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
max_date=(yesterday+timedelta(days=2)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
print('date window', min_date, max_date)

# shares from simple note 3084
shares={
    'Adrian': Decimal('36'),
    'Katie': Decimal('30'),
    'Martin': Decimal('35'),
    'Robin': Decimal('36'),
    'Matthew': Decimal('19'),
    'Melissa': Decimal('31'),
    'Glenn': Decimal('32'),
    'Brenda': Decimal('40'),
}

# contact emails for these friends (from earlier phone lookup - first friend relationship)
emails={
    'Adrian':'adrian_burt@gmail.com',
    'Katie':'kat_simp@gmail.com',
    'Martin':'mar_blac@gmail.com',
    'Robin':'roburton@gmail.com',
    'Matthew':'matthew.blac@gmail.com',
    'Melissa':'mel.bailey@gmail.com',
    'Glenn':'glenn.burton@gmail.com',
    'Brenda':'brenda.webe@gmail.com',
}

# helper to fetch all venmo transactions received between window with optional user_email filter

def fetch_received_transactions(user_email):
    all_tx=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        res=apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=access_token, user_email=user_email, direction='received',
                                         min_created_at=min_date, max_created_at=max_date,
                                         page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        print('tx page',page_index,'for',user_email,'count',len(res))
        if not res:
            break
        all_tx.extend(res)
        page_index+=1
        if page_index>20:
            break
    return all_tx

paid={}  # name -> total received
match_details={}
for name,amt in shares.items():
    email=emails[name]
    tx=fetch_received_transactions(email)
    # filter to those with amount>0
    # compute totals exactly by amount
    total=Decimal('0')
    details=[]
    for t in tx:
        # transaction amount can be float; convert safely
        t_amt=Decimal(str(t.get('amount')))
        desc=t.get('description','')
        created=t.get('created_at')
        # only consider transactions whose amount matches this share amount
        if t_amt==amt:
            total+=t_amt
            details.append({'transaction_id':t.get('transaction_id'), 'amount':float(t_amt), 'description':desc, 'created_at':created})
        else:
            # keep for debugging if close
            pass
    paid[name]= total
    match_details[name]=details
    print('Received matching transactions for',name,'share',amt,'count',len(details),'total',total)

print('Paid totals',paid)

from decimal import Decimal
import re
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Login to venmo
venmo_pw='gKI4^x3'
venmo_access=apis.venmo.login(username='kri-powe@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)
access_token=venmo_access['access_token']
print('venmo access_token', bool(access_token))

# Based on note 3084 shares
shares={
    'Adrian': Decimal('36'),
    'Katie': Decimal('30'),
    'Martin': Decimal('35'),
    'Robin': Decimal('36'),
    'Matthew': Decimal('19'),
    'Melissa': Decimal('31'),
    'Glenn': Decimal('32'),
    'Brenda': Decimal('40'),
}
# Emails from phone contacts
emails={
    'Adrian':'adrian_burt@gmail.com',
    'Katie':'kat_simp@gmail.com',
    'Martin':'mar_blac@gmail.com',
    'Robin':'roburton@gmail.com',
    'Matthew':'matthew.blac@gmail.com',
    'Melissa':'mel.bailey@gmail.com',
    'Glenn':'glenn.burton@gmail.com',
    'Brenda':'brenda.webe@gmail.com',
}

# Determine which have already paid by checking received transactions with description containing 'Friends Dinner'
phone_now=apis.phone.get_current_date_and_time()
cur_date=datetime.strptime(phone_now['date'], '%A, %b %d, %Y').date()
yesterday=cur_date-timedelta(days=1)
min_date=(yesterday-timedelta(days=3)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
max_date=(yesterday+timedelta(days=3)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
print('window',min_date,max_date)


def fetch_received_for_email(email):
    all_tx=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        res=apis.venmo.show_transactions(
            access_token=access_token,
            user_email=email,
            query='Friends Dinner',
            direction='received',
            min_created_at=min_date,
            max_created_at=max_date,
            page_index=page_index,
            page_limit=page_limit,
        )
        print('  page',page_index,'len',len(res),'for',email)
        if not res:
            break
        all_tx.extend(res)
        page_index+=1
        if page_index>30:
            break
    return all_tx

paid_names=set()
for name,email in emails.items():
    tx=fetch_received_for_email(email)
    # mark paid if any transaction amount equals their share (exact) and description matches
    amt_share=shares[name]
    found=False
    for t in tx:
        amt=Decimal(str(t.get('amount')))
        desc=t.get('description','') or ''
        if amt==amt_share and 'Friends Dinner' in desc:
            found=True
            break
    print('paid?',name,found,'tx_count',len(tx))
    if found:
        paid_names.add(name)

unpaid=[n for n in shares.keys() if n not in paid_names]
print('paid_names',paid_names)
print('unpaid',unpaid)

# Create payment requests for unpaid
created=[]
for name in unpaid:
    amount=float(shares[name])
    resp=apis.venmo.create_payment_request(
        user_email=emails[name],
        amount=amount,
        access_token=access_token,
        description='Friends Dinner',
        private=False,
    )
    print('created request for',name,'->',resp)
    created.append((name, resp.get('payment_request_id'), amount))

print('created_requests',created)
